description: Generate a pytest module: parametrized real assertions from {input, expected|throws} cases, skipped tests for described cases, fixtures

modulePath.description: Python module path, e.g. app.orders or app/orders.py

testCases.description: Test cases. Either a description string (generated as a pending test) or {name, input: [args...], expected} / {name, input, throws: true | "message"} for a real assertion.

throws.description: true, or a substring of the expected error message

name: generate_pytest_test
